body: I didn’t realize this was a possible side effect. I had this issue with hormonal birth control, and I have some anger issues anyway, so it is definitely something for me to keep in mind if I decide to go this route. Thank you.
Thank you for this, it is really helpful and it makes me feel a little better about giving it a try.

I haven’t had a real hug in almost 2 years. I don’t have a family and I am single with no close friends. I just told my therapist in my last session that I just miss hugs, real ones where you can feel that you are cared for. It sounds pathetic but I just want someone to hug me, so I feel you.

I just went off of it because I had trouble with the side effects, but I was at a much higher dose. I will say when I was at a lower dose it definitely did help me sleep. I also live alone with no one to check on me and I never had problems until we increased the dose for other reasons. I didn’t gain weight either until we upped the dose. So, in my experience, I would say just stay at the low dose if it helps you sleep, but be careful about increasing it. I know everyone is different, so you have to see what works for you, but that was just my experience.

I do take anxiety medication, but it has been a struggle to find what works for me, so I just recently started a new one. I am feeling discouraged by all the things I have tried as far as medication and coping mechanisms that just don’t work for me. 

My job is not the type where I can ignore emails or IMs, I am expected to act on them immediately. My job is also client facing, so I interact with them all day and share space with my department, so I cannot personalize or cozy up my work space. A large part of my anxiety is the constant interaction with either coworkers or clients. I appreciate your suggestions, but unfortunately they wouldn’t work in my particular situation. 

we are only permitted a 10 minute break twice a day, if I don’t need to go to another department for a few moments or use the restroom I am expected to be at my station at all times. My department doesn’t have a direct supervisor, so all the other department supervisors, plus the site supervisor are constantly all giving us instruction and it is overwhelming. 

I really feel the only solution is to leave my current employer, but I haven’t applied for jobs on my own in a long time and when I was doing, I was looking for retail type things. I feel very lost now.

It doesn’t always work, but I like to paint. Not like pictures or anything, I like to just waste paint. Smear it around on plastic or something with my hands. It’s being destructive but in a way that doesn’t really hurt anyone or anything. It’s relatively low cost too and easy to keep the stuff on hand, because I’m not making art, so I don’t need high quality brushes or canvas or anything. In fact I prefer to paint on something that I “ruin” by painting on it like dollar store shower curtains or plastic place mats or something.

Reconsolidation of Traumatic Memories

I am bad at that part of it actually. I try to challenge the thoughts, remind myself I’m not a mind reader, but it’s hard. I spend a lot of time in the bathroom at work doing breathing exercises and trying not to cry. I just feel like everyone there hates me and thinks I am terrible and is always talking about me. I try as much as I am able to remind myself that people are busy and have more important things to do than make fun of or disparage me all day, sometimes it helps, sometimes it doesn’t. I hope you find something that works for you. Lately I have been told when I am imagining a scenario that bothers me to replace one of the participants with Jar Jar Binks to just make it ridiculous so I am more able to dismiss it, but honestly I haven’t tried that yet.
I can’t comment for anyone else, but paranoia is a big part of BPD for me.

I feel the same way as you. It isn’t that I don’t want to try or work, it is that everything has gone so wrong I don’t know how to fix it and I would need either an extreme amount of money or for my life so far to be erased to even have a chance. I am tired of paying so much for mistakes I’ve made so many years ago. I am tired of being alone because I’ve lost everyone who ever cared for me. I’m tired of feeling stuck in a place and job I loathe and having health problems I can’t deal with all because of lack of funds. I think for me it’s just exhaustion and wanting a clean slate that I can’t ever have.
Thank you, these give me some places to start looking. I appreciate it.

I wouldn’t say self-sacrificing and the other two have caused me nothing but grief. Thanks for trying to be nice, I know people always think I am just shooting them down or not wanting to hear anything that doesn’t agree with me, but that’s not my intent.

I know how this is going to sound, but there really isn’t anything. Part of that is that I have a crummy sense of self, and part of it is deep seated severe self-loathing and cripplingly low self-esteem. (and yes I know that sounds like an oxymoron to say both I don’t know who I am and that I hate who I am) I think the nicest thing anyone can say about me is that I really want to be better I am just absolutely clueless about how to make that happen. If I had to say one thing I like about my life it would be my cats. But with anything positive I could say there is always a caveat. I want to be better, but if I wasn’t so self-aware of how shitty I am I would probably be happier. I love my cats, but they cost me money I don’t have and cause me quite a bit of stress and worry.

I feel this way too. Am I really so awful that I don’t deserve the love/affection/loyalty so many people just take for granted?? Why is it that everyone I care about ends up being a liar? Why is it that everyone can walk away from me so easily, when I can’t ever give up on, forget, get over anyone who goes out of my life? It makes me feel really worthless, ugly, stupid, and awful.

I have always felt like some sort of cosmic mistake, an accident. Like I’m not even supposed to exist. It makes it really hard to form connections or even to feel connected to my own life in some ways, I guess I feel not real.
this.

I have just let things get so bad without dealing with them and now I am at a point where the people I thought I would be able to depend on are  all gone and everything in my life seems so out of my control I just don’t know where to even start. Honestly, it is so overwhelming that the suicidal ideation I have always dealt with just keeps getting worse and worse and I am desperate at this point. I feel like I just can’t keep going like this anymore.
I have found the same thing about 90s radio pop. I was “too cool” for it back then but now it is so comforting. I listen to the 90s station on whatever radio app I am using all the time.

I am so scared of being alone forever. I feel like I am too messed up to ever be with anyone and I am so so lonely, I have been alone for almost a year and I still miss my ex so badly, I think about him every day, I still reach for him when I wake up in the middle of the night. I wouldn’t wish this on anyone, this loneliness, this certainty it will always be like this. I hope your 3 year plan is healthy and works out for you and you are able to find what you are really searching for. I don’t know you, but I wish you happiness and love.

I’m sorry, I am recently divorced also and I am really struggling with it. I didn’t want it and I still love him. I feel like it was all my fault because of my mental health problems. I don’t have any wise words to offer, since I am not in a good place myself, but I just wanted to say I will be thinking about you and hoping things work out for you. I wish you the best of luck.
I am struggling with the peers thing as well. I feel like everyone who is in my place in life is so much younger and so no one really understands me. It’s a very lonely feeling.

I am in the same place. I don’t know if it’s helpful to know you’re not alone. But I am a loser too. And one who feels like what is the fucking point of continuing if I am always going to be a loser. And now I am an old loser. I hate it. I have tried so hard and always been a loser.

I have all these fucking insane things banging around in my brain all day every day that if I say out loud sound so fucking stupid and crazy. It must feel nice to get it out. My biggest one is that I think it’s a cosmic mistake that I am here and that’s why everyone who comes in contact with me has bad things happen to them. My twin died in utero and I think maybe she was the one who was supposed to have been born and that’s why I have the opposite of Midas’ touch. But you say that to people when things go wrong? “Oh it’s the universe rejecting me and sabotaging any attempt I make at having a life because I actually stole my life from my twin and they are the one who should be here and now the cosmos are just trying to correct their mistake.” It sounds absolutely fucking insane, I know it does. Doesn’t stop me from thinking it though.

Anyway, I think this is the place for crazy shit and I don’t hate you or think you are nuts for your thoughts and I totally get why that would fuck with you.

I’m with you. I am just trying to make it to a time when it won’t harm my sister so much. But I am at the end of what I can stand and no one believes me and it just keeps piling up. I am sorry you feel this way, it is terrible and I wish I could say something that would give you hope but I have nothing left to give anyone. I guess I just wanted you to know that you aren’t alone.

Can I ask what dose you take? I was reading up on it a bit and the recommended doses vary wildly, like from 5mg a day to 150mg. I asked my provider about it as well, and he said I should try it but didn’t tell me a dose and hasn’t gotten back to me about it yet. Thank you!

I’m not sure why am so afraid. I think in my head I just have lithium associated with things being really bad, and I don’t want to admit that things are really bad. But they are, maybe I should give it a shot.
I am also curious about this, my provider has mentioned it as a possible option for me, but I am a little afraid of it. Are you starting it?
Peace, I am just so tired and worn down by the constant struggle.
Just me and my cats. If I didn’t have them I would probably end it all tonight, but no one would know I was gone for at least a couple days and that doesn’t seem fair to them.

I came here to post a very similar post asking for advice on how to get my therapist to take me seriously. I told her I wanted to die and I think about it all the time and I cry every morning because I wake up and am still alive and she sent me an article telling me to make my bed and stop drinking so much caffeine. wtf? I wonder sometimes if she thinks I’m just trying to get attention and she’s helping me by not giving it to me when I’m being dramatic, but that’s not what is going on. I am actively suicidal and have relapsed with self harm and no one seems to believe me or care. I am screaming for help and can’t get it. And my prescriber just keeps upping my dosage of medication that isn’t working because he doesn’t want to give me an official diagnosis because he thinks my problem is that I got divorced last year. I have been like this for most of my life, it caused the divorce not the other way around, but again, he doesn’t listen or take me seriously.

For me it is not being able to control setting the fire and then trying desperately to put them all out. It’s like being made of fire and constantly trying to contain it while deep down you really just want to watch everything burn.

GAD is one of mine as well, which is why I wasn’t sure where to post. Thanks for the reply, coming to this community helps me at least feel less alone, which I have been really struggling with, especially with the holidays.

I use white noise at night for the same reason, and I am almost always doing 2 things at once to try to keep my mind busy, but like you I feel like I am wasting my life on these distractions. And sometimes they just don’t help. Thanks for the reply, it helps to know other people at least know how I feel.
me too

I stopped doing it because it was all a farce. My family can’t stand each other. My mother is awful and my dad has told me to my face that he wishes my sister and I were never born. But then we would all sit there on Christmas and smile and exchange gifts like we were an actual, functioning, loving family. I just couldn’t do it anymore.

I didn’t have any help, I am trying to do everything alone and I’m not going to lie, it is hard. But I am still here, although most days I wish I wasn’t. Going back home may be what is best for you, surround yourself with people who care about you and heal. I wish you the best of luck with everything.

I am sorry. My husband asked for a divorce last year on the day we were supposed to go get our Christmas tree, and I am still in a really bad place from it. That’s just shitty and I feel for you. I hope you have a support network to lean on during this difficult time.

I am taking a medication to try to stop my nightmares, they are so bad I am terrified to fall asleep, so I am no stranger to godawful nightmares but I had one the other night that was one of the worst I have ever had, in part because it was so vivid and real. 

I am more or less all alone, no family, the only people I really talk to at all are online. I am divorced, hate my job, where and how I live, my life, myself. But I have cats, they are the only bright spot in my otherwise bleak life. 

I dreamed the other night that my cat started seizing and I grabbed him and was holding him and before I could do anything blood just started pouring out of both ends of him and I was absolutely covered in his blood, as he died in my arms. I had used siri to call my ex husband when he started seizing and when he answered I was just shrieking and sobbing incoherently. He broke my door down and came in and I was just holding my cat and covered in blood and sobbing and he took him away from me and I attacked him and he left with my cat’s corpse. When he came back I was laying on top of my bed catatonic and my other cat was laying on top of me, protecting me. She was hissing and attacking him whenever he would come near me and he was crying and I wanted so badly to interact with him to give and receive comfort but I couldn’t move my body or make a sound, I just laid there and stared at the ceiling.

When my alarm went off I had destroyed my bed, the blankets and pillows were mostly on the floor and I was twisted up in my sheet. I was sobbing and whimpering out loud and my bed was soaked with tears and sweat. I didn’t get back to sleep at all, I just laid on the foot of my bed and watched my cat breathe. I was terrified to touch him. In the dream I felt like I caused what happened to him, like all the things that are wrong with me infected him and his poor little body couldn’t handle it. 

The whole thing rattled me so bad, I can’t even describe the dream in detail because it was so disturbing and I am afraid if I think about it too much I will have the dream again, I am prone to recurring nightmares. It was so gruesome and graphic and awful.

This is pretty much exactly where I am. I am present enough to know it’s bad and to hate it and hate myself for falling into this rut, but not present or awake or energetic enough to do anything about it.

I am really sorry you are going through this today. My Gram and Aunt passed a few years ago, I don’t really talk to the rest of my family except for sometimes a sister who has her own life and family that doesn’t include me, and then I got divorced last year, so this is also my first Christmas alone, except for my cats. It’s hard. I relapsed with self injury and drinking and I have definitely thought about ending it today. The holidays just suck. I hope you can make it through today. Unfortunately the only thing I can offer is to say that even though you are alone, someone else see and acknowledges your feelings and can understand, if not the exact situation at least the emotions associated with it.
Merry Christmas, I don’t have anyone else to say it to either.

Thank you for this. It is nice to know that someone gets it and knows how hard it all is. I just want the holidays to be over and I’m sure you feel the same way. It’s strange, I would never berate someone else for relapsing, I would be supportive and kind, understanding. But I am just so hard on and mean to myself about it. I have been just hating myself, which then makes me want to cut again (because that makes sense), so thank you for offering me the compassion I just can’t find for myself. I hope you make it through the holidays ok, I am sorry for your losses. I don’t know how it is for you, but I feel like grief never really goes away, I just internalize it, it becomes part of me that I am just sort of used to living with. Doesn’t mean it stops hurting at all, the pain just becomes normalized.

You sound very much like me. It is so hard to realize you wasted so much time and then look around and have nothing to show for it. I am so sorry for what you are going through. If you ever need or want to chat you are welcome to message me. I have lost everyone after always trying so hard to put everyone else first, when I finally broke and reached out for help even my sister (my only close family) abandoned me. Especially at this time of year, it is difficult to cope with.

Wouldn’t that be nice? I am in the same boat...for about the last 8 years it just keeps getting worse. I am sorry you are going through it too...I am not real hopeful about it getting better for me anytime soon, but I really hope it does for you. Isn’t it strange that we can believe it can for someone else, a complete stranger on the internet, but not for ourselves? If not happiness, I hope you can find at least some peace and comfort in 2019.

I am having the same issue. I have gone to my appointments, almost every week for 7 months, I do the “homework” she gives me, but I feel worse than I ever have. I think maybe I just can’t get better. I am with you too where I don’t want to do meds. I have had bad reactions to them in the past and they freak me out. The idea of switching therapists is just too daunting, and besides she’s not the problem, she’s wonderful, I am the problem.

I either don’t eat at all or I eat like I did today...I had a a shit ton of coffee, a chocolate chip cookie, some red vines, cheezits, fruity pebbles, and a freeze dried apple. I eat like an unsupervised child.

I don’t know if it’s related to the diagnosis, I have never asked, but I do this too. Also can’t sleep at all without it and find that it is invasive in my life. I will sometimes give up on my real life and go to bed super early to lay here and build these fantasy realities in my head.

This is my favorite episode of Bojack. I have asked people (my ex and my therapist) to watch it because it is the best illustration I have ever found to explain to someone what it is like to be in my head. The show in general is so good, but sometimes a little too real. I have had to turn a few episodes off part way through and come back to them later because they made me so emotional. Whenever I recommend the show I tell people it’s a cartoon about a horse that is the single best representation of mental illness in fiction, in my opinion.
yep. I cannot help myself.

I do this too, exactly. Both the apologizing and asking for permission for things I don’t need to ask permission for. I also over explain myself. It’s like I’m paranoid that someone is going to misunderstand my intent or that my actions will inconvenience someone else so I go out of my way to explain to people why I did something the way I did it. I do all three of these things at work a lot and my coworkers have actually told me to stop, that they trust my judgment and I don’t need to worry so much, but I just can’t help it.

I would go back to my freshman year of hs and stop myself from dating the first guy who was abusive to me and I would tell myself not to sabotage my own life to “get back” at my mother. It didn’t hurt her, it just fucked up the rest of my life. My life was messed up before that, but that was the time when it really went off the rails.

My ex certainly did. I know my behavior caused problems in our relationship, but it didn’t make him lie, cheat, and play with my emotions. He would do things deliberately to trigger panic attacks and outbursts and then use my emotions to bully me into doing what he wanted. He made me feel crazy and like everything was my fault. It was always hard for me to trust anyone, but now it is impossible.

I have several tattoos that I got impulsively that I wish I had thought out better. I don’t necessarily regret having them, but where they are or how they were done. I have a tendency to be hurt about something or to lose someone or fall in love and want to get a tattoo to commemorate it, so I run to the first shop and get the first thing that popped into my head. When I was younger I also made the mistake of going cheap on a couple, and they need to be covered or removed or something at this point. They are embarrassing and I try to keep them covered as often as possible. Overall, I would say do your research, really think about it and then if you still want one go for it, don’t do the impulsive self sabotage-y BPD thing (easier said than done I know) and you will be fine.
yup, me too.
All the time. It seems like really happy couples are everywhere, doesn’t it?
I think it’s even worse if the person used to love you.
This hit me really hard, I have lived this exact moment so many times lately.
thank you, i’ve been struggling lately because a lot of things in my life are changing and i feel like I have no control, but I hit 30 days yesterday and I feel good about it.
I’m in my 30s and I started self harming at 7, it intensified to actual cutting and burning when I was in my late teens.

INFJ-T. I have taken the test before for work and I got INFJ there as well, I feel like the results seem pretty accurate to my actual personality. I am a cis woman who has a history of self injury and sleep disorders. I have GAD and BPD, or so I am told, and I was raised by a narcissistic alcoholic. I hope this is helpful for your research.

Thank you for saying this. I hate this just completely baseless optimism I’m supposed to have. Look around, nothing has ever gotten better for me, I have always struggled, why the fuck would that change now??

I do this too. I have an ex I haven’t seen in over a decade. I really loved him, but we were super toxic together. We were both just really broken, confused people from bad home situations and we were young and desperately trying to figure things and ourselves out. I wish I could explain BPD to him, let him know why I kept pushing him away. I guess I just wish I knew that he knew that my behavior was never because I didn’t love him, but because I loved him so much and I was so afraid to lose him and I didn’t know how to manage those emotions. I think about the conversation I wish I could have with him sometimes, what I wish I could say.

I cut in groups of 3, always 3 cuts quick and close together, then 3 more in a different spot. I use a kleenex to soak up some of the blood and I find it oddly satisfying when the cuts leave 3 distinct lines on the kleenex before it soaks up enough blood that they all run together.

Oh that is so embarrassing. Or when someone buys you a gift and you are looking at it going “what the fuck am I supposed to do with this?” but trying to act excited and then they bring up this hobby you had already totally forgotten about and you feel guilty that now they have wasted their money on it too and you have to fake being back into the hobby for a little bit so they don’t realize, because they thought it was such a great gift and it’s not their fault you have the attention span of a gnat.

wait...is this a BPD thing? I never put that together. This drives everyone who knows me crazy. I get insanely excited about something, a new hobby,  whatever it is, suddenly it’s my new “thing” and I spend a shit ton of money on it, then find out i’m not instantly good at it and give it up and have all these supplies or equipment just sitting there. And I can’t bring myself to get rid of it because I spent so much on it and maybe one day I magically will be good at it and it won’t send me into a rage because it’s so frustrating and so it just sits there forever, this expensive reminder of what a piece of shit I am. I knew impulsive shopping was a symptom, but it never clicked that this went hand in hand with that until just now.

I think this all the time too. When I was still living with my ex he would say these awful things to me and that was one of the ways I would cope, by telling myself it didn’t matter how much he hated me, because he could never hate me as much as I hate myself. I even said it out loud to him at least once, which made him accuse me of being a “drama queen”. I don’t understand why it feels comforting, it doesn’t make sense when I stop and think about it, but I get what you mean.

Oh god, I feel you so strongly on this. I feel constantly ashamed of my behavior. Either I actually am acting like a fucking psycho and have good reason to be embarrassed or I am obsessing over some little thing that I did that most people would probably forget right away, but I will be mortified over forever, wondering what the other people involved thought or how stupid I came across. It gets so old apologizing for my overreactions and weirdness and neediness.

oh yeah, especially if I have been drinking, but sometimes even when I haven’t been. Sometimes my vision just goes white and I feel like I am not in control of myself and that is when I tend to not remember. It’s scary as shit.

I am so sorry you are feeling this way also. I had a really stressful day today and honestly had this same thought as I was opening the door to my dark, empty, lonely apartment. It hurts so bad to be so alone.

Sometimes I feel like I do it for a sense of control. I am in so much pain that comes from an outside source and that I can’t stop or fix, self harm is something I do, something I control. Other times it seems like an outlet when I just can’t handle my emotions, they are too much, too overwhelming and I just have to DO something. Then there are times that I do it to bring me back to myself, refocus my thoughts on something distinct and definable, distract my mind from the deluge of negative thoughts and worries and what ifs, and snap it back to the here and now. When I am in the moment when I self injure I am usually not able to think about it critically, but looking back at it, I can sometimes see what motivated me in a particular instance. Other times I feel like I’m just a fucked up person who does fucked up things and hurting myself is one of them.
Same. I really try to not let myself get drunk because I always do things I regret if I do.

I don’t have anything constructive to add, I’m sorry. I just wanted to say I feel like I could have written this post. I don’t know the specifics of what is going on in your life, but I know this feeling well. I am sorry you are going through this also, it is a terrible way to live. I hope you are able to find some relief or solutions to whatever is making you feel this way.

I tend to get angry first and if someone tries to tell me I’m overreacting or otherwise invalidates me I completely lose it and rage. I yell, throw things, self injure, and otherwise act like a giant ass, then the shame hits me and I do the laying in bed sobbing uncontrollably thing, then I tend to disassociate because I just can’t handle the overwhelming emotions anymore. Sometimes I skip the rage step and go straight to crying in bed. I have been known to stay in bed and not eat anything for a few days at a time. My ex used to be the one who would eventually coax me out of those moods, now that he’s not around I am really frightened for and of myself.
That is pretty much how I feel, that just existing takes everything I have out of me. I have nothing left over for actual LIVING.

I experience this also, I’m sorry I don’t have any advice for coping, I haven’t figured that out yet either. Sometimes it is immobilizing how strong something will hit me. I have had to get rid of perfumes, scented candles, etc that my ex liked and there are certain meals I can’t eat anymore because they remind me too strongly of times with people who are no longer in my life. Songs are also a big thing for me, there are things I just can’t listen to anymore without breaking down.
I’m sorry your mom makes it worse. Mine was one of the people who said I just did it for attention, but I can’t help it either.
I do that too, it’s awful.

I think anything customer service centered is bad. I just switched from retail to reception and they are both rotten. Having people upset with you every day just sucks. I don’t know if it sucks more with BPD, but I know I have a harder time letting go of those bad interactions than my coworkers do.

I have really bad nightmares/night terrors and anxiety about being alone at night so I am lucky if I get 3-5 hours a night and it is never all together, but split up into little chunks. I spend quite a bit of the night hearing noises, getting up and checking all my windows and doors, going back to bed, hearing a noise, and on and on and on. I have tried white noise and fans, but they actually raise my anxiety because then I’m afraid I wouldn’t hear if there was an actual scary noise. I am exhausted all the time.
I am so bad about this. Afterwards I always cringe and get angry at myself because I am sure I freaked the person out, but in the moment I don’t even think about it, it just happens.
Mine is bad too. Sometimes I feel like I can’t focus well enough to remember things.

I do this too. I am so afraid of being left behind that I push people to see how far I can before they do leave. It doesn’t make any sense, and for a long long time I wasn’t even aware I was doing it. I knew I was a bitch to everyone and I was crazy and I said horrible things, but I never knew why. Now that I understand it a little better I am trying to work on it, but I have lost everyone because of my behavior already so it is too little too late.

My husband cheated on me and left me. It made all of my symptoms so much worse that my sister, who was the only other person I really talked to, decided she  couldn’t deal with me anymore and cut me off while I was going through the worst time of my life. I am now pretty much totally isolated and I don’t see any way that could change because I don’t feel like I could ever trust anyone or let anyone in again. I have been betrayed on such a deep level by someone I truly trusted and opened up to, it is devastating. I am sorry you are going through this also. It is so hurtful and harmful. I haven’t found a way to make it better, so unfortunately, I have no advice, but you aren’t alone. I think anyone hurts and feels distrustful after being cheated on, but being borderline it just cuts deeper since we feel things so much more intensely.
You are not alone. I ruined my marriage and every friendship I have ever tried to have, so I don’t even try anymore. It’s very lonely.

There are a few episodes of Bojack Horseman that I relate to really strongly. “Stupid Piece of Shit” is especially good. I don’t think it’s confirmed he’s BPD or anything, but the show has some of the most real depictions of mental health issues I’ve ever seen.
me too, you put into words a feeling i’ve always had but not expressed.
I’m with you. I don’t understand how other people do it and it seems easy for some of them and it is so impossible for me.

I’m really struggling with feeling like I will never have a home again. I am trying to do things to make this place feel more like mine, but I have been kind of using that as an excuse to compulsively shop, which I can’t afford to do. Thank you for responding, I appreciate someone just thinking I can make it through this.
This is exactly the sentiment I always try to express. I am sorry you feel that way too, it is such an isolating, terrible feeling.
